headline: Cryptocurrency markets show resilience amid broader AI-linked equity sell-off
summary: Cryptocurrencies maintained relative stability despite a $1 billion liquidation wave following a reversal in post-election AI stock rallies.
why: Bitcoin and other digital assets are increasingly monitored by institutional investors for their correlation with broader risk-on equity markets, particularly the technology sector.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Market volatility in the crypto sector is often linked to broader risk sentiment in equity markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The liquidation wave and the broader sell-off in AI-related equities created significant volatility in digital asset markets.
